name: Water heater
scene: A tank water heater on the floor (or a drain pan) in a utility room near a wall: tall cylindrical jacket (lathe), cold and hot pipes with a shutoff valve on the cold inlet at the top, T&P relief valve on the upper side with its discharge pipe running down, drain valve near the bottom front. Gas: burner access cover and gas control valve with knob near the bottom, flue on top. Electric: two element access panels on the front.

parts.label: Tank
parts.describe: Painted steel jacket (white, blue or tan), domed top, label on the front.

parts.label: Cold water valve
parts.describe: Valve on the cold inlet pipe above the tank (lever or round handle); normally open.

parts.label: T&P relief valve
parts.describe: Brass valve on the upper side with a lever on top and a discharge pipe down to near the floor.

parts.label: Drain valve
parts.describe: Brass or plastic hose-bib valve near the bottom front; turns open to drain into a garden hose.

parts.label: Sediment
parts.describe: Mineral sediment flushed out at the drain (clump or patch of mineral_scale).

parts.label: Gas control
parts.describe: Gas valve box near the bottom front with an OFF/PILOT/ON knob and a temperature dial (gas only).

parts.label: Gas knob
parts.describe: OFF / PILOT / ON knob on top of the gas control.

parts.label: Igniter button
parts.describe: Red or black push button beside the gas control that sparks the pilot.

parts.label: Burner cover
parts.describe: Access cover below the gas control; lifts off to see the pilot flame (glow).

parts.label: Upper element cover
parts.describe: Small square panel on the front with the upper heating element and thermostat behind it (electric only).

parts.label: Reset button
parts.describe: Red button on the upper thermostat behind the upper cover (electric only).

debris: rust or water patch on the floor or drain pan
views: low front for the drain valve and gas control
notes: Pick gas or electric from the appliance name or photos (gas has a flue pipe on top and a gas line to the control; electric has a conduit into the top). Run a garden hose (hose) from the drain valve when the fix drains the tank.
